final_message:
No: the firm's files show no fund we set up with a working American (deal-by-deal) waterfall. Every fund waterfall we drafted, marked up or reviewed is European (whole-fund). The one exception is the ICM Cascadia Co-Invest side letter (Ironside, matter 1023-00001), whose §3.4 says deal-by-deal. That was a single-asset co-invest where we acted for the LP, never invested and is dormant. Its LPA §6.02 says "whole fund", and its cross-references to a clawback and the carry article don't match the LPA. The Pinnacle CV deal-by-deal draft by other counsel was replaced with whole-fund at the client's instruction, and the Ridgeline sponsor refused our LP client's deal-by-deal request.
